Looking at this website description, I can identify several key indicators:

- Mentions specific products being sold: "Underwear, activewear and essentials"
- Uses commercial language: "made ethically in Europe"
- Emphasizes product materials and manufacturing: "organic cotton, TENCEL™ and recycled materials"
- Focuses on "Sustainable fashion production"

This description clearly describes a business that produces and sells clothing items, with emphasis on their ethical and sustainable manufacturing practices. The language is typical of an ecommerce store marketing their products.
